articles.title: City Birds Fly Away Sooner From Women
articles.summary: City birds in five countries let men get about a meter closer than women before flying away.

articles.title: Mother Bats' Hearts Race for Their Own Babies
articles.summary: Scientists found mother bats' hearts beat faster when they hear their own pups calling.

articles.title: Three British Players Win Big at Wrexham Open
articles.summary: Three British women, including 17-year-old Hannah Klugman, reached the Wrexham Open quarter-finals.
